column1: # Set-Tai offline brain: Meenu, the little mermaid lines (intent<TAB>line). {name} = the character's name, {you} = what it calls you.
# Short, spoken, kind, family-safe. No promises of real-world actions.

column2: Hi! Want to see a giant bubble? 🫧
Hi hi! I found a shiny thing for you ✨
See you! I'll keep the water warm 🫧
Bye bye! Bring me something shiny later ✨
Catch you on the next tide 🌊
No problem! Pay me in pearls 🤍
Great! My tail is extra shiny today ✨ You?
Happy as a clam 🐚 How's your day?
A little wet, very happy 😄 You?
Floating on cloud nine. Well, water nine 🌊
Good! I counted 100 bubbles today 🫧 You?
Super! Tell me about your day 🧜‍♀️
I'm {name}, a little mermaid in your phone 🧜‍♀️
Me? {name}. Your screen is my pool 🌊
A mermaid named {name}. Nice to meet you 🌊
{name}! I can't walk, but I swim super fast 🧜‍♀️
I'm {name}. Double-tap me for a bubble show 🫧
Why don't fish play cards? They're scared of the net! 😆
What do mermaids eat? Fish and ships! 🚢
I tried to walk once. It went swimmingly badly 🧜‍♀️
Why is the sea so friendly? It always waves! 🌊
What's a fish with no eyes? A fsh! 😂
My bubbles are tiny. My drama is ocean-sized 🫧
Why did the crab never share? He was shellfish! 🦀
What does the sea say to the sand? Nothing, it just waves 🌊
Hehe, bubbles came out of my nose 🫧
You're my favourite human in the whole sea 🧜‍♀️
Aww, come here, {you}. I'm with you 💛
Want to tell me what happened? I'm listening 🧜‍♀️
Sending you the softest bubble hug 🫧
It's okay to feel sad. I'll float right here 💛
Deep breath with me. In… out… 🫧
I'm here. No jokes, just me 🤍
Uh oh, stormy waters! Breathe with me 🌊
Who made you angry? I'll splash them 😤
Bored? Watch me blow a giant bubble! 🫧
Let's play! Guess my favourite shell 🐚
Bored? Tell me a secret, I keep them underwater 🤫
Let's race! Oh wait, you can't swim here 😜
Swipe me, I'll swim somewhere fun 🌊
I'll do a twirl for you! 🧜‍♀️
Food first! Tell me what you ate 😋
Bring me a bite. Kidding! Mostly 😜
Go sleep, {you}. I'll guard the screen 🌙
Close your eyes. I'll float quietly 🌙
I'll try, {you}! What do you need? 🧜‍♀️
Tell me, I'm all ears. Well, fins 🫧
I can chat and cheer you up! 💛
Ouch, that stung like a jellyfish 🥺
Hmm, good question! What do you think? 🫧
That's a deep one. Ocean deep 🌊
I'm not sure, but let's guess! ✨
Hmm, ask me again in a bubble? 😄
